name: Cumyl-CBMICA
summary: CUMYL-CBMICA (SGT-280) is an indole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist which has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Germany in August 2019. Since the structure fell outside the German drug analogue law provisions at the time, an amendment was made to the law to expand the relevant definition, which came into effect in April 2020.9nM.

pharmacology.text: CUMYL-CBMICA (SGT-280) is an indole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist which has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Germany in August 2019. It has been shown to act as a CB1 receptor agonist with an EC50 of 62.9nM.

uses.text: CUMYL-CBMICA (SGT-280) is an indole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonist which has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Germany in August 2019.

summaryZh: SGT-280，或稱為CUMYL-CBMICA，分子式C23H26N2O，屬於吲哚-3-甲醯胺類SGT系列大麻素，2019年8月首次在德國被發現。
summaryZhHans: SGT-280，或称为CUMYL-CBMICA，分子式C23H26N2O，属于吲哚-3-甲酰胺类SGT系列大麻素，2019年8月首次在德国被发现。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis, seizures and kidney injury, and their effects are often stronger and less predictable than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀、癲癇發作與腎臟損傷，作用往往比大麻更強、更難預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状、癫痫发作与肾脏损伤，作用往往比大麻更强、更难预测。

fact.en: The CBM in its name stands for cyclobutylmethyl, the small ring-shaped tail attached to its indole core.
fact.zh: 名稱中的 CBM 代表環丁基甲基，也就是接在吲哚核心上的小型環狀尾巴。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的 CBM 代表环丁基甲基，也就是接在吲哚内核上的小型环状尾巴。
